brief: 6 creator mistakes that cost me 2 years and $40K.

slots.title: PERFECTION
slots.body: I spent six months rewriting posts that never shipped. Done beats perfect when you’re starting from zero.

slots.title: TREND CHASING
slots.body: I jumped on every viral format until my audience had no clue what I stood for. Niche down, then scale up.

slots.title: NO LIST
slots.body: I built a hundred-thousand-follower audience on platforms I didn’t own. One algorithm change wiped out half my reach overnight.

slots.title: UNDERCHARGING
slots.body: I traded hours for dollars at rates that kept me broke. Raising prices actually attracted better clients and freed my calendar.

slots.title: NO SYSTEMS
slots.body: I refused to hire help until I burned out. Systems and delegation multiplied my output more than extra hustle ever could.

slots.title: IGNORING DATA
slots.body: I posted blindly and hoped something would stick. Looking at metrics once a week turned guessing into a real growth strategy.

slots.headline: BUILD SMART
slots.body: Steal my playbook and skip the expensive lessons. Your next two years can look very different.
